schema_note: Curated human docs for console vars. Not exhaustive. Keys match UI / consolevarlist dump ids (Hungarian k/g stripped). process: engine|anim|both. Recipe steps: {var,value} or {func,args}. Enum values are 0-based indices (same as stock listbox posts).

statusLegend.live: Documented and expected to affect runtime (default when omitted).
statusLegend.dead: Registered but not read after definition — control is a no-op. Glyph ⌀.
statusLegend.orphan: Declared but unused outside registration — treat like dead.
statusLegend.partial: Works only under extra conditions; see statusNote.
statusLegend.danger: Can break behavior, hang, or thrash; use carefully.

processNotes.both: May appear on either process (or both).

coverageNote: Progressive curated catalog (~198 keys in 14 vars/*.json shards). Engine dump ~800 / anim ~223 names in .docs/ — not exhaustive.
